request.query: Which passages state the same fact as either of these two statements? (1) Requests time out after 30 seconds. (2) Set `port` to change it. Requests time out after 60 seconds by default.
request.instructions: A passage answers only if it itself states the fact that the two statements disagree about: a value, version, limit, name, list or rule for the same thing. A passage that only mentions the topic does not answer.

documents.title: readme.md > Mini (synthetic test fixture) > Quick facts
documents.text:
## Quick facts

The server listens on port 8080 by default. Requests time out after 30 seconds.
Mini requires Node.js 20 or newer.

documents.title: docs/configuration.md > Configuration > `retries`
documents.text:
## `retries`

Failed requests are retried 3 times by default.

documents.title: docs/guide.md > Guide > Tuning
documents.text:
## Tuning

Failed requests are retried 3 times by default. Raise `retries` on flaky networks.
